'''Gerold''' was a noble of [[Gilneas (kingdom)|Gilneas]] and the lord of [[Gelnor]]. Along with Crown Prince [[Liam Greymane]] and [[Lord Darius Ravenwood]], he aided with assembling the [[Gilneas Brigade]] when King [[Genn Greymane]] refused to send a honor guard to escort the defenseless refugees sailing west to [[Kalimdor]]. While Lord Ravenwood readied a fleet in secret, Gerold assembled a force of stout Gelnorian dwarves and men to volunteer as the promised honor guard. Though the scheme was uncovered by King Greymane and the plotters harshly punished, the warriors found their way into the service of Lady [[Jaina Proudmoore]] regardless.<ref>[[The Prophet's Warnings and the Gilneas Brigade]]</ref>
